stations.title: Elspeth
stations.say: One card that fills itself in?

stations.title: trams.js
stations.text: Three trams, each with a number and a year.

captions: In the tram shed, Elspeth wants one card that fills itself in for every tram.
The cards were copied by hand, and the Foundry Belle got the wrong year.
You write TramCard with props and use it for each tram, in four tasks.
Each card now shows its own tram, straight from the list in trams.js.
Same three trams, one component. A new tram needs no copying.
